outcome: Development of Neuromyelitis Optica Spectrum Disorder (NMOSD)
Occurrence of first NMOSD attack within the year of delivery
Interval between first pregnancy and first NMOSD attack
cohort: The study included women from the patient registry of the neurology outpatient clinic in Tehran, Iran, who were diagnosed with Neuromyelitis Optica Spectrum Disorder (NMOSD) without any comorbidity.
finding: NMOSD onset or prognosis did not seem to be generally affected by pregnancy before disease onset, though for women with early disease onset, pregnancy might serve as a trigger for NMOSD development.
